notablePrerequisites:
Assault Suit attached to Tethered Griffin.
A player controls no enchantments.
description:
If needed, give control of Tethered Griffin to an opponent who controls no enchantments.
When Tethered Griffin's controller controls no enchantments, Tethered Griffin triggers, causing them to sacrifice it.
However, Tethered Griffin cannot be sacrificed due to Assault Suit.
Tethered Griffin triggers again, creating a mandatory infinite loop that causes the game to end in a draw.
